current: Organisation-level process certificate required by UN R155 before a vehicle type can be approved for cybersecurity. Based on ISO/SAE 21434 practices.
proposed: Organisation-level process certificate required by UN R155 before a vehicle type can be approved for cybersecurity. The CSMS defines organisational processes, responsibilities and governance to assess and treat vehicle cyber risks.
evidence: UN R155 paragraph 2.3: "Cyber Security Management System (CSMS)" means a systematic risk-based approach defining organisational processes, responsibilities and governance to treat risk associated with cyber threats to vehicles and protect them from cyber-attacks. Paragraph 7.2.1: For the assessment the Approval Authority or its Technical Service shall verify that the vehicle manufacturer has a Cyber Security Management System in place and shall verify its compliance with this Regulation. The instrument does not prescribe ISO/SAE 21434 as the basis of its CSMS requirements.
